title: Netech (Neeser Technik AG) — claimed by payload
description: CH · Manufacturing · Netech (Neeser Technik AG) is a Swiss engineering and industrial services company based in Seuzach. It specializes in comprehensive maintenance, retrofitting, and overhauls of industrial machinery and manufacturing systems. The firm provides end-to-end technical support for production facilities, covering mechanical engineering, pneumatics, and electrical control systems.
